item.title: Morgan County receives $750,000 to improve sewer infrastructure
item.description: MCCONNELSVILLE, Ohio – Morgan County will receive $750,000 in grants from the Ohio Department of Development to address sewer infrastructure. The Community Development Block Grant supports a $5.25 million project that will install new gravity sewers in and around McConnelsville and replace the Riverside Drive pump station.
